concept.title: EU Statement
concept.shortdesc: This device complies with Directive 2014/53/EU issued by the Commission of the European Community.

p.b: This device complies with Directive 2014/53/EU issued by the Commission of the European Community.

li.p: The product is a low power device, and its output power is lower than the RF exposure requirements in Europe.

In all cases assessment of the final product must be made against the Essential requirements of the Directive 2014/53/EUArticles 3.1(a) and (b), safety and EMC respectively, as well as any relevant Article 3.2 requirements.
